items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: What was it like behind the wheel for you? "Definitely the beginning of the session it was t…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：你坐在方向盘后面感觉怎么样？"比赛刚开始的时候确实很艰难。我觉得到后面确实变得容易了一些，但你需要跑几圈才能让半雨胎达到温度，所以非常非常具有挑战性。我们明天会努力向前推进。"
items.summary: Q: What was it like behind the wheel for you? "Definitely the beginning of the session it was tough. I think towards the end it was definitely getting easier but I think you needed a couple of laps to get temperature into the inters so it was very very challenging. We'll try and make our way forwards tomorrow."
items.summary_zh: 问：你坐在方向盘后面感觉怎么样？"比赛刚开始的时候确实很艰难。我觉得到后面确实变得容易了一些，但你需要跑几圈才能让半雨胎达到温度，所以非常非常具有挑战性。我们明天会努力向前推进。"
